links.comparator_used: Same four radiology residents reading CXRs without AI assistance (AI alone also measured separately)
links.outcome: Reader diagnostic performance (AUROC) for detecting clinically significant lesions on chest radiographs
links.effect: Reader AUROC 0.534-0.676 without AI vs 0.571-0.688 with AI (all p < 0.05); AI alone AUROC 0.648, sensitivity 35.3%, specificity 94.2%; modest boost mainly for less-experienced readers
links.tradeoff: Mean reading time was 2.96-10.27 s longer with AI assistance (all p < 0.05)
links.quote: The readers' AUROCs ranged from 0.534-0.676 without AI and 0.571-0.688 with AI (all p values < 0.05).

design_hint: local external validation in low-prevalence setting; reader with vs without AI assistance
